title: test: update React 18 hydration error snapshots
body:
## What

Updates the React 18 Pages Router hydration-error inline snapshots to match the compact rendered-tree excerpts introduced by #99008.

This is a test-only change. The runtime output is already intentional and is shared by webpack and Turbopack.

## Why this was missed

React 18 jobs are opt-in for pull requests through the run-react-18-tests label. #99008 did not have that label, so its React 18 snapshot branches were not exercised before merge.

## Verification

- NEXT_TEST_REACT_VERSION=18.3.1 pnpm test-dev-webpack test/development/acceptance/hydration-error.test.ts — 15 passed, 12 snapshots passed
- NEXT_TEST_REACT_VERSION=18.3.1 pnpm test-dev-turbo test/development/acceptance/hydration-error.test.ts — 15 passed, 12 snapshots passed
- Prettier and git diff --check
